paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Wednesday for 4 clubs across 4 levels, with Drew Thorpe producing the night's most notable performance.
Drew Thorpe worked 5.0 innings, allowing 3 hits and 1 earned run, with 0 walks and 6 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the third, on a 1-2 pitch a 92 mph four-seam fastball to strike out Phillip Glasser.
Charlotte Knights fell to Rochester Red Wings, 1-13.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 2-for-4, 1 run scored. He batted 5th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins beat Baltimore Orioles, 7-5.

Steven Brooks also appeared for Portland Sea Dogs at Double-A. He worked 2.0 innings, allowing 2 hits and 0 earned runs, with 0 walks and 1 strikeout. He started at P. Portland Sea Dogs fell to Binghamton Rumble Ponies, 5-13.
Alejandro Garza also appeared for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He went 1-for-3. He batted 6th and started at DH. Hill City Howlers fell to Myrtle Beach Pelicans, 1-3.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Chicago White Sox sent RHP Drew Thorpe on a rehab assignment to Charlotte Knights.
title: Drew Thorpe turns in a strong outing on the mound
